newsitem.title: USA: U.S. DLA amends Sept 27 stockpile tin sale.
newsitem.headline: U.S. DLA amends Sept 27 stockpile tin sale.

text.p: U.S. Defense Logistics Agency said Monday it was amending a sale of stockpile tin that it announced Friday.
The agency said it sold 110 tonnes of tin at its daily offering Friday to three firms at a unit price of $2.7325 a lb. On Friday, it said it had sold 100 tonnes to two firms.
DLA said it instead sold 80 tonnes to American Iron & Metal, 20 tonnes to Hirsch Metals and 10 tonnes to Ney Smelting.
